name: Send contracts automatically when CRM deals close

parameters.content:
## Send contracts automatically when CRM deals close

This workflow sends a VisiSign contract when your CRM posts a closed-won deal to n8n, then handles the VisiSign completion event.

### Tested path
1. Send the sample deal payload below to the **Deal Closed Webhook** test URL.
2. Confirm **Send Contract via VisiSign** creates a signature request.
3. Complete the signature request in VisiSign.
4. Confirm the **Contract Completed Trigger** receives the completion event and sends the CRM update request.

### Required setup
- Install the `n8n-nodes-visisign` community node.
- Add VisiSign API credentials.
- Configure your CRM automation to send the fields listed in the payload note.
- Set `crm_update_url` and `crm_authorization_header` from your CRM automation or replace the HTTP node with your CRM native n8n node.

### Sample test payload
```json
{
  "deal_id": "deal_1042",
  "deal_name": "Westholme Park Lease",
  "contact_name": "Penelope Kaster",
  "contact_email": "pennykaster@example.com",
  "contract_url": "https://api.visisign.app/samples/visisign-test-agreement.pdf",
  "crm_update_url": "https://httpbin.org/patch",
  "crm_authorization_header": "Bearer test-token",
  "sales_notification_email": "sales@example.com",
  "sender_email": "contracts@example.com"
}
```

### Incoming deal payload

The webhook expects a closed-won deal payload with contact, contract, and CRM callback fields. Use the sample payload in the overview note for a test run.

For production, map these fields from HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or your CRM webhook builder.

### Create the contract request

The VisiSign node uses the incoming `contract_url`, `contact_name`, and `contact_email`. The VisiSign sample PDF URL is public so the workflow can be tested before you connect real contract generation.

### Completion event

When all signers complete, VisiSign calls this trigger. The HTTP node posts the signed status to the CRM update URL supplied by the incoming deal payload.
